title: China in 26: EU-China trade relations
gist: A German-language MERICS podcast episode covers EU-China trade relations: the Beijing negotiations between Maros Sefcovic and Wang Wentao, the Franco-German suggestions to the EU Commission, and the way forward in the trade dispute. Only a short episode description is available.

insights.claim: EU Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic and his Chinese counterpart Wang Wentao held negotiations in Beijing whose results are analysed in this episode.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: EU-China trade-row outcomes affect tariff and market-access risk for exporters on both sides.

insights.claim: Franco-German suggestions to the EU Commission on handling China trade are a topic of discussion, alongside ways ahead in the trade row.
insights.speaker: MERICS
insights.so_what: Franco-German positioning shapes the EU's collective stance toward China trade measures.
